name: supplyquest-hq
description: SupplyQuest HQ — a 3D agent workspace for operating a small Canadian import business, with evidence-labelled research, deterministic finance, and backend-enforced approvals.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sqhq/shared && npm run build -w @sqhq/server && npm run build -w @sqhq/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sqhq/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sqhq/server && npm run typecheck -w @sqhq/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sqhq/shared && npm run test -w @sqhq/server
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @sqhq/server & npm run dev -w @sqhq/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
